llm.notes: Gemma 4 E4B is the default local multimodal model. Put your LM Studio GGUF here, or update localPath. The launcher disables reasoning by default for fast companion replies.

asr.notes: Use tiny/base/small for low-end machines; use large-v3-turbo for best quality on CUDA.

tts.notes: The WebSocket TTS server still uses your current faster-qwen3/Qwen adapter. CUDA pack uses faster-qwen3 when available.

vision.notes: Optional Gemma 4 E4B multimodal projector for llama.cpp screen vision. Download the matching mmproj GGUF here, or set enabled=false to disable screen vision. The launcher appends --mmproj only when this file exists.
